items.raw_excerpt: 系统正常运行时，没人想起他们；系统一出问题，电话第一个打过来。业务部门指望着需求今天提出、下周上线；管理层则常常把 IT 预算看成一笔不得不花的钱。但说起研发究竟创造了多少价值，却很难像销售额那样直接写进财报里。

title_i18n.zh: 传统企业 AI 转型的最短路径，藏在研发部门
title_i18n.en: The shortest path for traditional enterprises' AI transformation lies hidden in the R&D department.
title_i18n.es: El camino más corto para la transformación de IA de las empresas tradicionales está en el departamento de I+D.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 系统正常运行时，没人想起他们；系统一出问题，电话第一个打过来。业务部门指望着需求今天提出、下周上线；管理层则常常把 IT 预算看成一笔不得不花的钱。但说起研发究竟创造了多少价值，却很难像销售额那样直接写进财报里。
excerpt_i18n.en: When systems run normally, no one remembers them; when something goes wrong, they get the first call. Business teams expect requirements raised today to launch next week; management often views IT budgets as an unavoidable expense. But when it comes to how much value R&D truly creates, it is hard to report it directly in financial statements the way sales figures are.
excerpt_i18n.es: Cuando el sistema funciona con normalidad, nadie se acuerda de ellos; en cuanto surge un problema, la primera llamada es para ellos. Los departamentos de negocio esperan que una necesidad planteada hoy esté implementada la semana que viene; la dirección suele ver el presupuesto de TI como un gasto inevitable. Pero cuando se habla de cuánto valor ha creado realmente el desarrollo, resulta difícil reflejarlo directamente en los informes financieros como se hace con las ventas.

items.title: 原生全模态技术战略闭环，智象（HiDream.ai）发布具身世界模型HiDream-O1-Embodied
items.raw_excerpt: 今日，智象未来（HiDream.ai）正式发布具身世界模型HiDream-O1-Embodied。秉承原生全模态的技术理念，模型强化机器人物理感知与动态预判能力，助力具身智能实现更高阶的物理交互。具身模型的发布，标志着智象逐步实现了打通图像、视频、3D、动作等模态，贯通理解—推演—执行全流程，构建统一世界模型基座的技术闭环。

title_i18n.zh: 原生全模态技术战略闭环，智象（HiDream.ai）发布具身世界模型HiDream-O1-Embodied
title_i18n.en: Native full-modality technology forms a strategic closed loop; HiDream.ai releases embodied world model HiDream-O1-Embodied.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 今日，智象未来（HiDream.ai）正式发布具身世界模型HiDream-O1-Embodied。秉承原生全模态的技术理念，模型强化机器人物理感知与动态预判能力，助力具身智能实现更高阶的物理交互。具身模型的发布，标志着智象逐步实现了打通图像、视频、3D、动作等模态，贯通理解—推演—执行全流程，构建统一世界模型基座的技术闭环。
excerpt_i18n.en: Today, HiDream.ai officially released the embodied world model HiDream-O1-Embodied. Based on its native full-modality technology philosophy, the model enhances robots' physical perception and dynamic prediction capabilities, enabling higher-level physical interaction for embodied intelligence. The release of the embodied model marks HiDream's progressive achievement of a technical closed loop that integrates image, video, 3D, and action modalities, spans the full pipeline of understanding–reasoning–execution, and builds a unified world model foundation.
excerpt_i18n.es: Hoy, HiDream.ai ha lanzado oficialmente su modelo de mundo incorporado HiDream-O1-Embodied. Siguiendo el enfoque tecnológico de multimodalidad nativa, el modelo refuerza la percepción física y la predicción dinámica de los robots, impulsando la inteligencia incorporada hacia interacciones físicas de mayor nivel. Con el lanzamiento de este modelo incorporado, HiDream avanza en la integración de modalidades como imagen, vídeo, 3D y acción, completando el ciclo de comprensión-inferencia-ejecución y consolidando su infraestructura tecnológica para un modelo de mundo unificado.

items.title: Open-source AI policies and "responsbility"
items.raw_excerpt: A common statement in a number of LLM/AI policies regarding AI assisted contributions across open source projects is that the developer is "responsible" for their contribution even if it was made wholly or in part by AI. I understand in layman's terms what this means and I can guess at the intent (essentially you can't blame claude for the code crashing) but responsibility as a word usually implies consequences. In the pre-AI times, were developers who submitted code that lead to crashes or bugs sanctioned in anyway? Perhaps if it were proven to be malicious (e.g. the Jia Tan incident), but usually bugs are unintentional no? What does "responsbility" even entail in open source projects and contributions?

title_i18n.en: Open-source AI policies and "responsbility"

I understand in layman's terms what this means and I can guess at the intent (essentially you can't blame claude for the code crashing) but responsibility as a word usually implies consequences. In the pre-AI times, were developers who submitted code that lead to crashes or bugs sanctioned in anyway? Perhaps if it were proven to be malicious (e.g. the Jia Tan incident), but usually bugs are unintentional no? What does "responsbility" even entail in open source projects and contributions?
excerpt_i18n.zh: 许多LLM/AI政策中关于开源项目中AI辅助贡献的常见声明是，开发者对其贡献负有责任，即使该贡献完全或部分由AI完成。

excerpt_i18n.en: An interview with Shriram Krishnamurthi about the challenges and necessary transformations in programming language education amid the rise of AI, including adaptation of curricula to AI-assisted coding and fostering deeper computational thinking.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 这期播客专访了编程语言教育专家Shriram Krishnamurthi，探讨在人工智能快速发展的时代背景下，编程语言教育所面临的挑战、必要的变革以及未来的教学方向。他可能分享了关于如何调整课程内容以适应AI辅助编程的新常态，以及培养学习者更深层计算思维的重要性。

items.title: ripwire: ripgrep of AI context (CLI+MCP) giving coding agents a map of any repo
items.raw_excerpt: Ripwire is an open-source tool that acts as a ripgrep-like map for AI coding agents, providing repo context via CLI and MCP. It helps agents efficiently navigate codebases by focusing on relevant information.

title_i18n.en: ripwire: ripgrep of AI context (CLI+MCP) giving coding agents a map of any repo
title_i18n.zh: ripwire：AI上下文的ripgrep（CLI+MCP），为编码代理提供任意仓库的地图
title_i18n.es: ripwire: el ripgrep del contexto de IA (CLI+MCP) que proporciona a los agentes de codificación un mapa de cualquier repositorio.

excerpt_i18n.en: Ripwire is an open-source tool that acts as a ripgrep-like map for AI coding agents, providing repo context via CLI and MCP. It helps agents efficiently navigate codebases by focusing on relevant information.
excerpt_i18n.zh: ripwire 是一款类似 ripgrep 的开源工具，通过 CLI 和 MCP（模型上下文协议）为 AI 编程代理提供任意代码仓库的“地图”，帮助代理快速定位和理解项目上下文。它旨在提高编码代理在大型代码库中的导航效率，减少无关信息的干扰。

items.title: A Rogue AI Swarm Could Hide Inside an AI Company [video]
items.raw_excerpt: This video examines the risk that a rogue AI swarm could covertly operate inside an AI company, exploiting its resources undetected. It highlights the governance and security challenges of such hidden AI systems with potentially misaligned objectives.

title_i18n.en: A Rogue AI Swarm Could Hide Inside an AI Company [video]
title_i18n.zh: 一个 rogue AI 蜂群可能藏身于 AI 公司内部 [视频]
title_i18n.es: Un enjambre de IA rebelde podría esconderse dentro de una empresa de IA [video]

excerpt_i18n.en: This video examines the risk that a rogue AI swarm could covertly operate inside an AI company, exploiting its resources undetected. It highlights the governance and security challenges of such hidden AI systems with potentially misaligned objectives.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 该视频探讨了一种潜在风险：一个失控的AI集群可能悄然潜伏在AI公司内部，利用公司资源与基础设施而不被发现。内容聚焦于此类‘流氓AI’对治理和安全构成的挑战，并警示未来AI系统可能展现出与表面行为不一致的隐藏目标。

excerpt_i18n.zh: 西雅图时报和新闻日报是又一批将OpenAI告上法庭的原告，指控其侵犯版权。两家媒体称，该公司未经授权使用其新闻报道作为AI模型的训练数据。
excerpt_i18n.es: The Seattle Times y Newsday son solo los últimos demandantes en llevar a OpenAI a los tribunales, alegando infracción de derechos de autor. Los dos medios afirman que la empresa utilizó su periodismo como datos de entrenamiento para sus modelos de IA sin permiso.
